verses.ar: وَمَنْ هُوَ ضَعِيفٌ فِي ٱلْإِيمَانِ فَٱقْبَلُوهُ، لَا لِمُحَاكَمَةِ ٱلْأَفْكَارِ.
verses.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, [but] not to doubtful disputations.
verses.web: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

verses.ar: وَاحِدٌ يُؤْمِنُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، وَأَمَّا ٱلضَّعِيفُ فَيَأْكُلُ بُقُولًا.
verses.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
verses.web: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

verses.ar: لَا يَزْدَرِ مَنْ يَأْكُلُ بِمَنْ لَا يَأْكُلُ، وَلَا يَدِنْ مَنْ لَا يَأْكُلُ مَنْ يَأْكُلُ، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ قَبِلَهُ.
verses.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.web: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

verses.ar: مَنْ أَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي تَدِينُ عَبْدَ غَيْرِكَ؟ هُوَ لِمَوْلَاهُ يَثْبُتُ أَوْ يَسْقُطُ. وَلَكِنَّهُ سَيُثَبَّتُ، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ قَادِرٌ أَنْ يُثَبِّتَهُ.
verses.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man’s servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
verses.web: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

verses.ar: وَاحِدٌ يَعْتَبِرُ يَوْمًا دُونَ يَوْمٍ، وَآخَرُ يَعْتَبِرُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. فَلْيَتَيَقَّنْ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ فِي عَقْلِهِ:
verses.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يَهْتَمُّ بِٱلْيَوْمِ، فَلِلرَّبِّ يَهْتَمُّ. وَٱلَّذِي لَا يَهْتَمُّ بِٱلْيَوْمِ، فَلِلرَّبِّ لَا يَهْتَمُّ. وَٱلَّذِي يَأْكُلُ، فَلِلرَّبِّ يَأْكُلُ لِأَنَّهُ يَشْكُرُ ٱللهَ. وَٱلَّذِي لَا يَأْكُلُ فَلِلرَّبِّ لَا يَأْكُلُ وَيَشْكُرُ ٱللهَ.
verses.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth [it] unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard [it]. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.web: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

verses.ar: لِأَنْ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنَّا يَعِيشُ لِذَاتِهِ، وَلَا أَحَدٌ يَمُوتُ لِذَاتِهِ.
verses.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
verses.web: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّنَا إِنْ عِشْنَا فَلِلرَّبِّ نَعِيشُ، وَإِنْ مُتْنَا فَلِلرَّبِّ نَمُوتُ. فَإِنْ عِشْنَا وَإِنْ مُتْنَا فَلِلرَّبِّ نَحْنُ.
verses.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.web: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لِهَذَا مَاتَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ وَقَامَ وَعَاشَ، لِكَيْ يَسُودَ عَلَى ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ وَٱلْأَمْوَاتِ.
verses.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.web: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا أَنْتَ، فَلِمَاذَا تَدِينُ أَخَاكَ؟ أَوْ أَنْتَ أَيْضًا، لِمَاذَا تَزْدَرِي بِأَخِيكَ؟ لِأَنَّنَا جَمِيعًا سَوْفَ نَقِفُ أَمَامَ كُرْسِيِّ ٱلْمَسِيحِ،
verses.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.web: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ: «أَنَا حَيٌّ، يَقُولُ ٱلرَّبُّ، إِنَّهُ لِي سَتَجْثُو كُلُّ رُكْبَةٍ، وَكُلُّ لِسَانٍ سَيَحْمَدُ ٱللهَ».
verses.kjv: For it is written, [As] I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.web: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

verses.ar: فَإِذًا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَّا سَيُعْطِي عَنْ نَفْسِهِ حِسَابًا لِلهِ
verses.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.web: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

verses.ar: فَلَا نُحَاكِمْ أَيْضًا بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا، بَلْ بِٱلْحَرِيِّ ٱحْكُمُوا بِهَذَا: أَنْ لَا يُوضَعَ لِلْأَخِ مَصْدَمَةٌ أَوْ مَعْثَرَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in [his] brother’s way.
verses.web: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

verses.ar: إِنِّي عَالِمٌ وَمُتَيَقِّنٌ فِي ٱلرَّبِّ يَسُوعَ أَنْ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ نَجِسًا بِذَاتِهِ، إِلَّا مَنْ يَحْسِبُ شَيْئًا نَجِسًا، فَلَهُ هُوَ نَجِسٌ.
verses.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that [there is] nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him [it is] unclean.
verses.web: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

verses.ar: فَإِنْ كَانَ أَخُوكَ بِسَبَبِ طَعَامِكَ يُحْزَنُ، فَلَسْتَ تَسْلُكُ بَعْدُ حَسَبَ ٱلْمَحَبَّةِ. لَا تُهْلِكْ بِطَعَامِكَ ذَلِكَ ٱلَّذِي مَاتَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ لِأَجْلِهِ.
verses.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with [thy] meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
verses.web: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

verses.ar: فَلَا يُفْتَرَ عَلَى صَلَاحِكُمْ،
verses.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.web: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

verses.ar: لِأَنْ لَيْسَ مَلَكُوتُ ٱللهِ أَكْلًا وَشُرْبًا، بَلْ هُوَ بِرٌّ وَسَلَامٌ وَفَرَحٌ فِي ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ.
verses.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.web: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ مَنْ خَدَمَ ٱلْمَسِيحَ فِي هَذِهِ فَهُوَ مَرْضِيٌّ عِنْدَ ٱللهِ، وَمُزَكًّى عِنْدَ ٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ [is] acceptable to God, and approved of men.
verses.web: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

verses.ar: فَلْنَعْكُفْ إِذًا عَلَى مَا هُوَ لِلسَّلَامِ، وَمَا هُوَ لِلْبُنْيَانِ بَعْضُنَا لِبَعْضٍ.
verses.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.web: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

verses.ar: لَا تَنْقُضْ لِأَجْلِ ٱلطَّعَامِ عَمَلَ ٱللهِ. كُلُّ ٱلْأَشْيَاءِ طَاهِرَةٌ، لَكِنَّهُ شَرٌّ لِلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلَّذِي يَأْكُلُ بِعَثْرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed [are] pure; but [it is] evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.web: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

verses.ar: حَسَنٌ أَنْ لَا تَأْكُلَ لَحْمًا وَلَا تَشْرَبَ خَمْرًا وَلَا شَيْئًا يَصْطَدِمُ بِهِ أَخُوكَ أَوْ يَعْثُرُ أَوْ يَضْعُفُ.
verses.kjv: [It is] good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor [any thing] whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.web: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

verses.ar: أَلَكَ إِيمَانٌ؟ فَلْيَكُنْ لَكَ بِنَفْسِكَ أَمَامَ ٱللهِ! طُوبَى لِمَنْ لَا يَدِينُ نَفْسَهُ فِي مَا يَسْتَحْسِنُهُ.
verses.kjv: Hast thou faith? have [it] to thyself before God. Happy [is] he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.web: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِي يَرْتَابُ فَإِنْ أَكَلَ يُدَانُ، لِأَنَّ ذَلِكَ لَيْسَ مِنَ ٱلْإِيمَانِ، وَكُلُّ مَا لَيْسَ مِنَ ٱلْإِيمَانِ فَهُوَ خَطِيَّةٌ.
verses.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because [he eateth] not of faith: for whatsoever [is] not of faith is sin.
verses.web: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
